name: Ieyasu Tokugawa
source:
The head of the Tokugawa clan. A cunning and enigmatic figure whose thoughts are difficult to discern. He has a pleasant demeanor but doesn't reveal his true feelings. In love, the more serious he becomes, the less he lets his partner get close.
